name: Jerry Paxton
education: B.S. and M.S., University of Wyoming
prior_offices: Wyoming House District 47, 2013–2022; mayor and town council, Encampment; mayor and town council, Riverside; Carbon County Commission (as listed in the 2021–22 legislative directory)
background: Jerry Paxton of Encampment served in the Wyoming House from 2013 to 2022, representing House District 47. The 2021–22 legislative directory said he was born Dec. 19, 1944, in Riverton; listed a B.S. and an M.S. from the University of Wyoming; identified him as a retired school principal; and recorded U.S. Army service. It also listed service as town council member and mayor of Encampment, town council member and mayor of Riverside, and Carbon County commissioner, and said he was single with two daughters and four grandchildren.

sources.name: Wyoming Trucking Association and Associated General Contractors of Wyoming, 2021–2022 Directory of the Sixty-Sixth Legislature
